title: Herbert Vere Evatt
summary: Australian jurist and Labor politician, born at East Maitland, New South Wales. A High Court judge from 1930 to 1940, he served as Attorney-General and Minister for External Affairs from 1941 and presided over the third regular session of the UN General Assembly in 1948, which adopted the Universal Declaration of Human Rights.

uncertainty.note: Birth year from the UN biography; both years as given by the Museum of Australian Democracy.
